> This task was originally part of the ir-deal-materials module and has been merged into this plugin. Applicable to requests to produce new materials; if the user only provides existing files for review or organization, route back to `ir-deal-materials`.

## Use When

User requests preparation of a pre-meeting company profile, peer benchmarking, or speaking notes for ECM (equity capital markets) meetings, management meetings, or investor communications.

## Ask First

1. Meeting counterparties and purpose (pre-IPO engagement, follow-on offering, non-deal roadshow, management meeting).
2. Audience (internal team, investment bank, institutional investors) and confidentiality level.
3. Data as_of date; whether there are upstream research conclusions or user-verified facts available for reuse.
4. Delivery format: document, presentation, or both.

## Workflow

1. Obtain facts from public sources or upstream research (handoff from `equity-research`); document data as_of date and source hierarchy; comply with `data-source-policy.md`.
2. Organize company overview, financial summary, peer benchmarking, capital markets history (issuances, share price performance, shareholder structure), recent controversies, and market focal points.
3. Generate talking points and anticipated Q&A outlines; distill research into audience-relevant information while retaining sources, risks, and caveats.
4. Before generating files, select template and naming per `output-contracts.md`; before publishing or external distribution, complete fact, copyright, privacy, and authorization checks (trigger `execution-safety.md`).

## Defaults

- Default to 4–6 comparable companies for peer benchmarking; metrics per `metric-dictionary.md`.
- Financial summary default to LTM + the two most recent full fiscal years; annotate `as_of`.
- Segregate unverified rumors and sell-side viewpoints and source them; do not mix with factual content.

## Pre-Delivery Checks

- Key facts must be traceable to public sources or upstream research conclusions; facts without sources must not enter the profile.
- Ensure data as_of date, currency, and units are consistent throughout the profile.
- If including non-public information, confirm privacy classification and audience authorization (`privacy-security.md`).
